question: Return category and total units sold on completed orders from 2025-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive. Include only categories with sales and sort by category.
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at>='2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at<'2026-01-01' AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: Return the top 3 products by completed units sold from 2025-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive. Return product_id and units. Sort by units descending, then product_id ascending. Only products with sales.
